readme: Plymouth, MN Municipal Elections by Ward, 2014 to 2024
Mayor and City Council, November general elections. Prepared October 2026.
What is in this workbook

Precinct Data: one row per precinct per election. Registered voters, ballots cast, votes cast in each city race, top-of-ticket results, and each precinct's share in the current (2022) wards. Blue text = source data.
Candidate Data: precinct-level votes for every mayor and council candidate, including write-ins.
Ward Turnout (As Drawn): totals by ward using the ward lines in force for that election. Formulas sum the Precinct Data sheet.
Ward Turnout (Current Lines): every election rebuilt onto the 2022 ward lines, so wards can be compared across all six cycles. 2014 to 2020 figures are estimates.
Averages & Trends: ward averages and changes (2-year, 5-year, versus the prior three cycles, and like-for-like by election type).
Election Type: mayor/midterm years versus council-only/presidential years.
Results by Ward: every city race, votes and percent by ward, winner, and margin.
Citywide Races (Current Lines): mayor and at-large results rebuilt onto the current wards.
Partisan Context: top-of-ticket (President or Governor) DFL vs. Republican results by ward.
Crosswalk: how each 2012-plan precinct was allocated to the 2022 wards.
Definitions
Registered = voters registered at 7 a.m. on Election Day plus Election Day registrations (SOS precinct statistics).
Ballots cast = total number of people who voted in the precinct (SOS "total voting").
City-race votes = total votes cast in that race, including write-ins. In every race here voters chose one candidate.
Drop-off = share of voters who cast a ballot but did not vote in that race: 1 minus (race votes / ballots cast).
Turnout = ballots cast / registered.
Two-year change = 2022 to 2024. Five-year change = 2020 to 2024 (both presidential years). "Vs. prior 3" = 2024 compared with the average of 2018, 2020 and 2022.
Ballot changes are percent changes; turnout, drop-off and margins are changes in percentage points.
Election calendar in this period

Mayor on ballot: 2014, 2018, 2022 (all midterm years). Council-only: 2016, 2020, 2024 (all presidential years). Because the two line up exactly, the "mayor effect" and the "midterm effect" cannot be separated with Plymouth data alone.
Ward seats: Wards 2 and 4 in midterm years; Wards 1 and 3 in presidential years. One at-large seat every cycle. 2014 also had a special election for Ward 3.
Redistricting and reconciliation

2014 to 2020 used the 2012 plan (23 precincts). The city redrew wards and precincts in 2022 (21 precincts). Precinct codes were reused, so the same code can describe a different area before and after 2022.

To rebuild 2014 to 2020 on current lines, each old precinct was overlaid on the 2022 wards using state GIS precinct maps. Where an old precinct was split, its votes were divided in proportion to overlap area weighted by 2024 voter density. Shares under 2% were treated as mapping slivers and dropped. 19 of 23 old precincts fall entirely in one current ward; 4 were split (see Crosswalk).
Ward-seat races are shown only as drawn at the time, since those contests were held in the old wards.
Sources

Minnesota Secretary of State election results text files (local precinct results, precinct statistics, precinct table, President/Governor by precinct), electionresultsfiles.sos.mn.gov, elections of 11/4/2014 through 11/5/2024.
Minnesota Secretary of State / Minnesota Geospatial Commons, General Election Results by Precinct 2012-2020 and 2022-2030 (precinct boundaries), gis.data.mn.gov.
Ballots cast by precinct were cross-checked against the GIS files for 2014, 2020, 2022 and 2024; all match.
Municipal results on the SOS site are labeled unofficial; the city canvass is the official record.
crosswalkNotes: Share = overlap area x 2024 voter density, normalized per old precinct. Shares under 2% dropped as mapping slivers. 2014 uses 2014 precinct shapes; 2016 to 2020 use 2020 shapes (minor boundary edits between them).
